official_sources.finding: contains excludes a geometry that lies only on the boundary; boundary membership therefore cannot be inferred from contains alone.
covers returns true when no point of B lies outside A and includes boundary points, making boundary-touch semantics explicit.
covered_by is the converse of covers and can independently replay the same inclusion relation.
contains_properly requires no common boundary points, so it is stricter than contains and covers.
intersects is true when geometries share any portion of space, including touching or covering cases.
prepared geometries accelerate repeated predicates such as contains, covers, intersects and touches without changing the predicate chosen.
GEOS documents covers as more inclusive than contains and explicitly includes boundary points.
GEOS touches is defined through DE-9IM boundary/interior relationships, allowing exact topology replay.
GEOS relate exposes the DE-9IM matrix so predicate disagreements can be audited at the topology-matrix level.
GEOS normalize reorganizes geometry into canonical form, useful for deterministic geometry serialization comparisons.
A valid polygon may contain holes; shell and holes are represented by LinearRings and ring orientation does not determine polygon validity semantics.
orient_polygons can enforce consistent exterior/interior ring orientation for deterministic serialization while preserving polygonal content.
is_valid identifies whether a geometry is well formed; missing values are not treated as valid geometries.
is_valid_reason exposes the reason and location class for invalidity such as self-intersection, enabling fail-closed diagnostics.
make_valid linework preserves edges and vertices as much as possible and can produce complex valid outputs.
make_valid structure repairs shells and holes according to their structural roles; repair method therefore belongs in provenance.
MakeValid can change a polygon into a multi-geometry or lower-dimensional geometry after dimensional collapse, so repaired type must be checked.
set_precision rounds coordinates to an explicit grid and may remove duplicate vertices or collapse narrow components.
set_precision valid_output preserves valid topology while pointwise mode can yield invalid geometry, so precision mode must be pinned.
precision reduction can change vertex order and geometry form, so raw coordinate ordering cannot be a semantic membership rule.
intersection accepts an explicit grid_size; precision-grid choice can alter the shared geometry and must be recorded.
GEOS precision reduction can preserve polygon topology via snap-rounding, while pointwise reduction can create invalid results.
default polygon rasterization generally selects pixels whose center lies within the polygon rather than every touched pixel.
ALL_TOUCHED includes all pixels touched by polygons or lines, producing a different membership policy from center-based rasterization.
when ALL_TOUCHED is enabled, feature order can affect edge pixel values when features touch, so order must be deterministic.
GDAL notes behavior is unspecified when a polygon just touches a pixel center under normal rasterization, requiring an explicit fail-closed edge policy.
nested polygons used with inverse rasterization require GEOS for correct results, making library capability part of runtime provenance.
zonal statistics supports center, all-touched and fractional pixel policies; these are distinct membership semantics and cannot be mixed silently.
fractional zonal membership computes a coverage fraction for intersecting cells, distinct from binary center/all-touched selection.
ST_Covers tests that every point of B lies in the interior or boundary of A and is generally preferred to ST_Contains for inclusive boundary semantics.
ST_Touches requires shared points while interiors do not intersect, allowing explicit boundary-only classification.
ST_IsValid tests OGC-style 2D validity and reports invalidity details, so target parcel geometry must be validated before membership.
ST_IsValidReason returns a diagnostic reason for invalid geometry, enabling reproducible rejection records.
ST_MakeValid can preserve vertices while changing polygon structure or dimensionality; repaired output cannot silently replace source geometry without a digest.
coverage_is_valid requires polygonal coverage edges to match exactly without overlap while allowing holes, useful for parcel-neighbour topology QA.
coverage gap_width can flag narrow gaps and coverage_invalid_edges can identify the offending edges.
GEOS validity requires polygon rings not to self-intersect and interior rings to remain inside exterior rings.
GEOS validity checks are two-dimensional for polygon topology; Z/M values do not repair invalid XY membership geometry.
normalize orders coordinates, rings and multipart components consistently for exact normalized-geometry replay.
polygonize excludes NoData or externally masked pixels and can use diagonal connectivity, showing connectivity/mask policy must not be conflated with parcel-boundary membership.
